front.title: Cross-Owner Agent Use Cases and Requirements: Spending, Delegation Depth, Ownership, Disclosure and Retention

abstract.t: This document describes use cases where an AI agent acting for one Owner asks an agent acting for a different Owner to provide/receive information, process or store data or otherwise work on an agent's behalf. This communication can be unidirectional or bidirectional. It lists the requirements that those cases place on an agent dialog protocol, mainly in five areas: a spending limit that stays with the work as it is passed on, a limit on how many times the work may be passed on, a way to check which Owner an agent acts for, the sender's control over which information about its Owner is disclosed, and how long that information may be kept. It does not propose a protocol. It is offered as input to the working group's use cases and requirements document.
